notes: Published clearance facts that the cat6 contract has no field for, kept verbatim rather than dropped. GPU thickness: the default configuration is stated as 4-slot, and the only published millimetre figure is conditional -- 'with a 25mm thick fan installed at the bottom, the GPU thickness will be limited to 61mm, allowing for only a 3-slot GPU'. GPU presence: 'when installing a radiator and fan combo, there will be no space for the GPU'. Both depend on a cooling configuration this project does not model, so neither is recorded as a clearance limit. PSU position S4: the ATX PSU SIDE chart marks S4 as incompatible with an ATX PSU, which is a mounting-position restriction rather than a GPU-length limit, so it is kept here instead of being written as a maxGpuLength branch with no figure.
